## 🚀 Getting Started
**Steps to begin:**
1. Fork the repository
2. Clone your fork locally
3. Set up the development environment (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
4. Create a new branch for your changes
5. Make your changes
6. Test your changes
7. Submit a pull request

## 💡 Tips for Success
- Read the contributing guidelines carefully
- Ask questions if something is unclear
- Start small and gradually take on bigger challenges
- Focus on quality over quantity
- Be patient and respectful in all interactions

### Claiming This Issue
**To claim this issue:**
1. Comment "I'd like to work on this" below
2. Wait for maintainer approval
3. Get assigned to the issue
4. Start working and ask questions as needed

**Note:** Issues are typically held for 7 days after assignment. If you need more time, just let us know!
